name: GIN-Dock-Wallpaper
description: Unified Smart Hot-Corner Dock Bar & 4K Wallpaper Calendar HUD Engine for Windows 10/11
author: GinCz / Vladimir Bulantsev & Antigravity
features: 24 Curated Artistic & Graphic Fonts: Expanded font collection with calligraphic, handwritten, and display typography (Gabriola, Ink Free, Impact, Sitka Banner, etc.)
Streamlined Calendar Controls with 'Off' Toggle: Clean 'Календарь:' header with 5 full-width buttons (Нет, Маленький, Средний, Большой, Крупный)
Dock Brand Button Modernization: Removed 'GIN' text; added 20 selectable icons (Windows Start, Rocket, Diamond, Crown, etc.) in Docker settings
Wallpaper Download Animated Tray & Dock Glow: System tray and dock brand icon animate with a pulsing cyan halo during 4K wallpaper retrieval
2-Column Wallpaper Themes Layout: Fixed category text overlap and expanded with 'Dark Horse' (Темная лошадка), Macro, Aviation, Retrowave, Fantasy, and Deep Sea
Deterministic Top-Left Window Placement: Settings window opens with ~2 cm margin from top-left of working area
Reliable Auto-Update Engine: Numeric version comparison and CDN cache-busting query
